releases.displayName: Song of The Priaire Optimization Update!

items.text: Dear Mayors,

Since the release of Song of The Prairie, we have been committed to optimizing the game alongside adding new content in each major update. From early texture optimization to improvements in the rendering pipeline and lighting effects, we have consistently strived to enhance the game's performance. Of course, there is still room for further optimization, and this time we have carried out secondary optimization on the in-game art resources, mainly focusing on more than 40 UI art assets.

Song of The Prairie contains a large number of UI art resources distributed almost everywhere visible to players. During development, these resources presented the following issues due to ensuring future needs:
Unreasonable dimensions: Some UI resources were excessively large, far exceeding the game's requirements. Oversized resources inevitably lead to longer loading times.

Atlas arrangement and cropping: As 2D resources, UI elements are typically packed into atlases (collections of images with the same function or at the same hierarchy). The arrangement of these atlases and the cropping size of the entire atlas also affect game optimization.
Redundant resources: Some unused resources, although not appearing in the game, were packed into the same atlas and would still be loaded in certain scenarios.
The above three points indeed affect game optimization to a certain extent, whether when opening UI interfaces or loading the game.
In response to these three issues, we have optimized all UI resources:
Reduced dimensions: We have downsized unnecessarily large resources to minimize waste.

Reorganized atlas cropping and arrangement: We adjusted the irrational arrangement and cropping of atlases.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/a386159e33460b5bd20c91f52a62229e9bd8d4e5.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/e195c288465ac9f8841653eb63cf27577d95ad4a.png"]
Removed redundant resources.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/3c86ea33332b819e58760603647bcf302ce7df33.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/a59453ad82241eaa39f16ad01b37c8af64aea164.png"]
Finally, we have also made subtle tweaks to some resources, though these may be hard to notice.

Additionally, we are pleased to announce that we have fixed the PS crashing issue. This problem was caused by a memory leak in specific versions of the development tools and Unity engine, which has now been resolved. The game content is now kept consistent with the PC version.
Thank you for your support and love for Song of The Prairie. We will continue to optimize the game in the future.

items.text: Dear Mayors,

It’s been a while, and we’re finally here to bring you the latest news about Song of The Prairie. The upcoming days in May will be full of excitement, including a major game update, daily special promotions, and the launch of Wonderland on Desktop for Song of The Prairie. Without further ado, let’s dive into the update details!

Mage Nat was actually the first character players met upon entering the town, but he vanished after dropping some mysterious hints. The next time players encounter him is on the 100th floor of the mine, possessed by a demon king. After defeating the demon king with the Goddess’ help, players take the unconscious Nat to a small cottage by the town. Now, Nat, who has been asleep for nearly 200 days, has finally woken up!

The mysterious Nat has always been one of the most anticipated characters among players. We’ve received countless messages from domestic and international players hoping to see Nat’s story completed. Now, we’ve finally continued his storyline. Wonder what interactions players will have with Nat next? Welcome to Prairie Town to experience it! Oh, and we’ve also added romantic storylines for players who want to pursue a relationship with Nat!

Of course, just adding storylines wouldn’t be enough—we know what players really want. That’s why we’ve added dating and marriage events for the mage! Now, players can invite Nat on dates in Prairie Town and even marry him! I wonder if Nat will maintain his cold and proud demeanor while in love?
Inner Space

With love and marriage comes the "Inner Space," a crucial part for players to explore a character’s inner world. We believe Nat’s Spiritual Space will hold many mysteries to uncover. Will we learn what happened between him and the demon king? Why was he possessed? What connections does he have with the town’s residents? Feel free to explore his Inner Space!

Is the prideful mage opening a shop? After arriving in Prairie Town, Nat has set up his own shop—whether out of necessity or generosity. He uses magic to craft potions, and players can exchange items he needs for treasures or potions that grant buffs! Don’t forget to visit the mage’s shop next time you’re in town.
Now, Nat has become a member of the town. Although his past was fearsome, Prairie Town welcomes everyone!
Due to high demand, we’ve added same-sex marriage content. Now, regardless of the player’s gender, you can initiate marriage events with any character you love!

In our last major update, we released the Year 3 main storyline but temporarily omitted translations to let players experience the new content faster. We apologize to players in other regions for this. Now, the Year 3 content has been fully translated. Welcome to Prairie Town to see what interesting stories unfold in the third year!

We’ve received feedback that the overall pace of Song of The Prairie felt too slow, with too much content locked too far into the game, making it hard for some players to experience it in short playthroughs. This time, we’ve significantly optimized the first 10 days of the storyline and the pacing of item/tool acquisition to make the early game more engaging. Players with save files from the first 10 days are recommended to start a new game for the best experience!
We also have news about Wonderland on Desktop! Development is complete, and it will launch on May 22 with a base price of 9.9 RMB in China and an initial 10% discount. Don’t miss it if you like it

notes.title: New Crop and Fruit Low-Poly Models

items.text: As always, optimization work continues... and it might just last a lifetime! This time, we’ve added low-poly models for crops, fruits, and other assets. Low-poly models are an essential part of 3D game optimization. In games, especially open-world games without indoor loading, rendering every object in high detail would not only waste computer resources but also place a heavy burden on game performance. After all, distant objects on the screen don’t need much detail, just like how the human eye can’t clearly see objects that are too far away in real life. This is where low-poly models come into play. By reducing polygon counts and texture resolution for objects far from the camera, we can significantly save resources.

In this update, we’ve added low-poly models for crops and fruits. As a farming simulation game, Song of the Pasture offers vast areas for planting. When these areas are fully cultivated, the scene becomes truly spectacular. Adding low-poly models for crops will undoubtedly bring noticeable optimization improvements.
That’s a brief introduction to the updates in version 1.2. For more details, we welcome players to come and experience it all in Pasture Town!

Lastly, we have some exciting news to share. While actively preparing for the new version of Song of the Pasture, we’ve also been working on a mini game set in the world of Prairie Town, titled Song of the Prairie: Wonderland on Desktop. The store page is now released on Steam, and we’ll have more detailed announcements about this game in the future. Stay tuned!

Props, decors and toys are indispensable part in Song of The Prairie gameplay. They bring you interesting experience, sometime they are good helpers in your farm life, moreover, they will bring you surprise when you explore Prairie Town! In this update, we added prop and toy. Hello, Our Responsible Mayors.

I’m so glad to take you to have a look about this major update which also is the first major update in 1.0. And it will be Mid Autumn Festival soon. There will be discount for such a festival! We appreciate that you participated in previous poll, that was our motivation to make changes. Now, with out further ado, let’s get in to the preview.

This is the major process of this update.We’ve received so many voices and suggestions from you guys in that poll and collected enough feedback for changes. We thank you all for your support and passion. After the poll, we started to optimize and adjust the models. As the poll result, we adjusted the proportion to B2, G2 in the reference.

Although Song of The Prairie is cartoon and fairy tale style, but if you look at the character faces and body shape, you will realize that bigger head looks out of proportion. Of course, we understand that some players may get use to this proportion during the long-time playing. But we still believe, shrinking character’s head could make them more beautiful and fit.

Just like we said in poll announcement, proportion adjustment would be a huge project. Even, the visual change was just the shrinking of head, but this kind of change has involved all the items and props related to head in game world. Like headwears , hats and haircuts. After the adjustment, all the anchors on those items, obviously, were not match anymore, so, we need to change them. In creating interface. Although the UI operation has changed not that much, but all the parameters need to be changed one by one to fit smaller head. More important, the animations and movements, we don’t want frequent overlapping or some strange abnormal behaviors. The rigs and animation ranges also need to be adjusted. All in all, it was not that easy.
But we still made it! Now all the adjustment has been done, with more reasonable proportion, we believe the visual experience will be significantly improved.
NPC Outfit-Changing Optimization

In previous, we added the function to change NPC outfits, and it’ s very popular. We could see NPC with different outfits from your screenshots. This time, we continually optimized this function. You could gift something like decorations, jewelries. But sometimes, these decorations were not that match to the outfits. And the only choice was replacing those decorations by gifting NCP a new one. Now, things will be different. After the optimization, we added empty option for decoration slots. If you don’t like those decorations, just hide them, it’s much convenient isn’t it?

We will optimize the resources or performance in every major update. As always, we optimized the model, texture resources as always so that to shorten reloading time. Before, reading files might take a long time if those files contained long-term gameplay data. Now, reload time will be shorter technically.
This kind of optimization may hard to witness, but will effect your gameplay experience, that’s why we never stop the optimization.

Nectar machine is a helper in farm life. They process nectar for cooking and feeding flower tail beasts. But you could put in so many kinds of flowers to process. So, when you enter it’s UI, you have to wait for it to finish it’s sorting process to flowers then show you the interface. This kind of experience was bothering. After the update, you don’t have to wait for the whole process, it will display the interface then begin to load the process. It looks like a simple change on logic, but for game experience, it’s a great leap.

0.9 will be Updated in June 12, 2024 (GMT)
Hello, villagers. It's great to see you all again.

Now more than a year has passed since the release of the EA version of Song Of The Prairie, and we are very grateful for your support over the past year. It is your support and feedback that inspired us to continuously complete the game content and optimize the game experience. The Prairie Town is also becoming more and more bountiful and beautiful under your witness.

Now, Song Of The Prairie has been steadily updated to 0.9, which will be the last major update in EA stage and the prelude to version 1.0. We're glad to have stuck it out to this point, have draw a perfect period to EA stage. What excites us even more is that this period doesn't mean the end, but a new beginning.
Now let's step into the 0.9 update preview. This preview will be divided into two parts: new content, system innovation & optimization.
Never Stop
New content continues to be the focus of every major update, no different in 0.9. As this time we finally bring the long-awaited Achievement System.
Steam Achievement System is an important part for gaming experience, and this system has been absent before.

However, this system has been on our development agenda for a long time. But why we haven’t put thin in game? Firstly, the game was not yet in its full version, releasing achievement system too early might not be able to integrate well with the gameplay in subsequent updates, which, we believed, would lead to an unpleasant experience.
Secondly, as a simulation game, the conditions for winning achievements need to be repeatedly considered. It is important to set the system challenging without ruining the player's experience.
Therefore, we decided to add the Achievement System in the more mature 0.9.

This update will add more than 50 achievements, including hidden ones. From daily play to completing quests, from collecting items to making dishes, and even some unexpected actions, almost every aspect of gameplay will be included, and this system will smoothly throughout the entire game experience.
We believe that after the update, this system will bring more goals and fun to your life in Prairie Town!
Note: To experience the whole achievement system, starting a new game is recommended.

Prairie has always welcomed travelers from all over the world, and after the calling of many gamers from non-English-speaking regions, now language will finally no longer be a barrier. With the update of 0.9, Song Of The Prairie will support for: German, French, Spanish, Russian, Korean, Portuguese, and Italian.
Above languages have already been adapted in most of the interfaces, including but not limited to: main menu, MEMO, backpack, dialog, Inner Space, and so on.
Of course, the localization may not be perfect in some interfaces, and we hope that you will give us feedback on Discord or Steam discussion, and we will take every comment seriously.
Sharp your tools before working.

Tools are the most used props during the gameplay, and they also affect players' efficiency and experience the most. We added enhancements for those tools including: Lobster Cleaver, Thunder Hammer, Ancient Hammer, Sunflower Hammer, Magic Broom, and The God of Cookery’s Big Black Wok . What’s more, we have added higher level versions for those tools and added corresponding enhancements to both the original and higher level tools.

Their enhancements range from increasing proficiency, to reducing stamina consumption. With these additional effects, these tools are more than just cosmetic decorations, also the real efficiency boosters.
These tools can now be upgraded to a higher level version, which will enhanced better than the original one, further heightening your gaming experience!
Progress comes from endless innovation.

In the past, customization in the character creation session actually had limitations. Player’s identities could only be picked among a few preset characters; gender, country, and profession could not be changed; players could only choose between identity and profession. eventually, players had to put up with bonus that they didn't need. In short, players basically couldn't choose an identity that met their needs.
After update, the whole situation will be changed.

1. We've completely changed the background in the character creation interface, from a preset scene into the town with a wagon. This change helps to connect to the opening of the game better, and is more in line with the story development of the character coming to Prairie Town.

2. With the innovation of the whole character creation system, the UI interface has also made corresponding changes. Now the interface will become more concise and intuitive. Without lengthy descriptions to occupy the visual space, players can focus more on creating a character, thus creating a character that better meets the needs.

3. The most important part of this system innovation, a complete character customization system. Now your identity is finally no longer bound by the various attributes of a preset character; the gender is no longer tied to your profession, country, or other properties. Players are free to choose various attributes of their characters and completely create their own character. We believe it will make players feel that I am not just operating a character, but my own avatar experiencing life in Prairie Town!

Whenever you start a new game, don't you get tired of those old animations? It's okay, in 0.9, we have drastically reorganized the original cutscene. We hope you will have a new experience when enter the game again! Here are the details of changes:
1. First time on the farm

In previous versions, there were only a few simple pictures to show you the farm when you first arrived. After 0.9 update, there will be more footage to show the layout of the farm and its surroundings in a more comprehensive way, including the scene across the river, so that players can have a rough idea of the cultivable area after entering the game for the first time.
2. Encounter animations for multiple characters

In order to better express the story, highlight the characters' personalities, and deepen the impressions of them. We also changed the first encounter animations of some characters, including Du, Kroc, Abby, and Lori. First, we rewrote the story development of some characters when they meet the player to better match the settings of their characters. Secondly, we added and optimized the performance of many narrative shots to make them more dynamic and visually appealing. Finally we added more close-ups to emphasize the narrative.

As always, we will continue to optimize resources in 0.9. In the early 0.7, we’ve replaced the rendering pipeline and optimized some texture resources. In 0.8, we've gone one step further, optimized some building models resources, significantly enhanced the light effects at night, and made some adjustments to the game's color.
In the new version (0.9), we have adjusted some of the outdoor natural landscapes.

We have "sculpted" some of the rocks in the town scene. They are no longer as bland and boring as before, but are now more angular, with sharper connections. They look more aesthetically pleasing to the eye.

We've also optimized the textures of rocks to give them a more natural iron-grey color, while the white lines outlining the corners emphasize their three-dimensional volume and amplify the structures as they would appear in nature. Finally, complemented them by the hidden green moss to make the visual effect of the rock come to life.
Except natural landscapes, we also optimized some other facilities, but more for resource management than for visual effects.

The texture resources for some of decors and furniture have been optimized for performance. In previous versions, these objects and furniture had their own texture resources, which increased some computational stress at runtime. After the optimization in 0.9, we have integrated the texture resources without changing the visual effect, which will theoretically improve the performance of the game to a certain extent.
1. Helpers Ai Performance
The training to helpers is still going, and we continue to optimize the behavior of the helpers based on 0.8.

The residents of Prairie Town are very thoughtful, no exception on helpers. In order for them to do their jobs better, we have optimized the behavioral patterns of the helpers so that they don't perform unnecessary activities as they did before, such as running from one place to another.
They also no longer respond to your greetings in the same way; they finally have their own personalities and will respond just like what they should.
2. Partner Behavior Optimization
After the release of the wedding system in 0.8, many players must have been started their post-wedding life. For the better experience, we have optimized some parts in this system accordingly.

Before, when your partner was on a day off, he/she would just sit quietly and think about things, perhaps what to eat later? Now they would do something they like, cleaning the house, cook a meal or reading a book in peace.
Numerical optimization work is related to game experience, it cannot be slowed down, in 0.9 we still adjusted some of the numerical value.
1. Prosperity score adjustment.

The town's prosperity is a measure of your contributions as town’s mayor, and the previous criteria seemed a bit too harsh. In 0.9, our dear secretary Wallis has slightly modified the town's prosperity rating. She increases the prosperity scores that you could acquire in every stage of your friendship with residents, and she also increases the scores when helpers are at a higher comfort level.

2. Increased the stamina limit of some helpers. After a period of training, their physical strength has become better. After this, they will spend less time on eating or resting and work harder, and they will participate in your commissions more. Maybe they will be seen less being slack when you supervise them.
Note: These changes will work after start a new game!
3. Adjusted the prices of some store commissions and the amount of delivered materials, mainly in Abby’s Cabin and the Death Mine.

Business in Abby’s Cabin and Death mines have not been doing so well lately. So, they increased efficiency while lowered their commission prices! Now, when you entrust logging and mining commission, except paying less gold, they will also be able to bring back more materials when the commission is completed.
Currently, the commission price for logging and mining has been reduced from 500 to 400.
The delivered number of main output materials, replacement output materials, and output materials with failure working is doubled.
4. Buff effects increase

Song Of The Prairie has already added a variety of buffs in previous updates. You can also obtain buffs in various ways and play the game more easily with their help. However, compared to the fast-passing time in game, buffs’ short duration is really difficult to reflect their advantages.

In order to make this design more meaningful, we adjusted the duration for almost all buffs to avoid some embarrassing situations like, buff ends before being noticed, players have to repeat unnecessary behaviors in order to sustain buffs effects. We believe that this change will significantly increase the usefulness and presence of buffs.
The road is long but there is a beam of light from the sun.

This preview of the 0.9 update has nearly come to an end, and we are still working steadily on each update to lay a solid foundation for the complete edition. Of course, the announcement is not exhaustive to conclude everything. For more content welcome to enter the Prairie Town to explore. At the same time for some bug fixes and optimizations, will also be released on announcements after the update of 0.9.

Thank you for your support and love, it is your support and love gives us great motivation, so that we can hold great enthusiasm to promote the development. It is your support and love gives us countless inspiration, so that Prairie Town is becoming more and more vibrant. It is also your support and love to create a passionate atmosphere for game communities, so that Prairie Town's warmth and harmony can be spread outside the screen!
We reached to the dawn, and we're excited to wait for a complete edition with all of you.
If you like our game, share it with anyone, and we'll see you in the new version.

Hello Villagers!
In December 27, 2023 (GMT), Song of the Prairie 0.7 will arrive! We’re so glad to share the news and that would be another solid step towards the full version.

We are still following the previous pace, which is, the main focus of development will be keeping the stability of game in the first month after the update. Then push forward to develop new versions. And new updates will be released after the development and testing. This will be the pattern until the game could be run as full version.

New content will be seen after every update, and most of the problems or bugs will be fixed. We’ll keep following some remaining glitches also. As for the feedback from different personal experience, we will do the analyse discussion then make the decision to optimize them or not. Because from the previous experience, the changes we made for some players would gain complains of the others.

But of course, valuing advise form everybody is our motto. Make a contact with us if you have any thoughts. We will take care of it. As you can see, the Performance Optimization you’ve been mentioned for a long time has improved in 0.7!

This part is too important to ignore. Although we did some emergency adjustments at the beginning of release, but it was far from our expectation. Because of many reasons during the development, we had to delay the large scale optimization to 0.7 rather than the last one. Sincere apology for this. About the optimization, we started in “Rendering Pipeline” and “Model Resources”.
We decided to transplant “Rendering Pipeline” to lower the requirement of hardware, to increase the calculating efficiency and to customize rendering performance more flexibly.
We ever used “Builtin Renderpipeline” which has lower efficiency than “Universal Renderpipeline”

More than just improving efficiency, “Universal Renderpipeline” could also allow us to customize rendering. Which means the unnecessary calculation of resources caused by the previous non-costumed rendering pipeline can be avoid. For example, some unnecessary content would be rendered in game, which will suppress the efficiency and increase the requirement of hardware. But now under the help of brand new rendering pipeline, our team could take advantage of it to optimize the certain features. Such as, customizing grassland rendering system, weather system, skin textures and unique renderer, etc.
Batch processing of the Bind and Draw commands can reduce GPU setup between draw calls.

This work contains two parts, transplantation and optimization. Changing the pipeline means the previous rendered content will be discarded. Our team will re-render all the scenes, buildings and characters models. It’s a massive work. But we have finished part of it, it was exciting! And the rest parts are in progress.
More than just pipeline, model resources such as textures have been remade also.

This kind of optimization is also to improve the performance. Present graphic and texture procession could save more resources than the previous. For example, redistributing UV for some models could guarantee more details and higher clarity even with minimum textures. At the same time, we believe the probability of crash and lagging after the long-term gameplay can be improved.

We planed to remake all the textures for buildings originally, but obviously it’s a large process. Also the renovation may involve in model changes. So we adjusted our plan. Model resources will be optimized by plan, but in different batches. In 0.7 the main part of the optimizations are Residents Buildings and some decors(fences/street lamps/market stalls/road signs), etc.
We are trying our best to stuff more content in game all the time. So, there isn’t only optimization but also new content.
In upcoming 0.7, a new area will be revealed in Song of the Prairie, Second Homeland.

Years ago, bunch of people escaped from the persecution of Demon King to the Goddess blessed land which is Prairie Town. But the surge of population caused much trouble for the management. A new area have been expanded at the outskirt of town named “Second Homeland”. However, when the world restored in peace, refugees were back to their motherland and the incomplete “Second Homeland” was abandoned.

Now, Prairie Town thrives again, it’s time to renovate this new area! About the gameplay, Second Homeland mainly brings you a new area and expands helpers function. Players could build houses for helpers, decorate Second Homeland, arrange helpers to become assistants of stores in town and join some new activities, etc. Here are the important parts of Second Homeland, Police Outpost, Construction Zone, Theme Stalls, Decorations and Activity Plaza. Those are not all but the most important components of the following game content expansion.
Don’t forget to open the path to Second Homeland by completing the quest in Autumn!

Prosperity system will be open when you start a new game. Players could check the Prosperity Reports anytime to know the status of Prairie Town. It includes Buildings Score, Villagers Score, Trade Score, Helpers Score and Environment Score and these will decide your Final Score. The standard is S>A>B>C>D>E. The higher score is the higher weekly payment you will receive.
An important management center. Where do helpers live and what their work are can be arranged here. Also, upgrading the Outpost could increase the maximal recruit positions of helpers.

Allow me to remind you, we upgraded the despatch system of stores. In previous version, players could only send out storekeepers to work. But now you could arrange helpers to assist stores or despatch these assistants do your commissions too. Now, the Creative Workshop, Abby’s Cabin, Death Mine, House of Mermaid, Blacksmith and Fashion Store may be shorthanded. Not only could you do the arrangement by Second Homeland, but Order Board in front of stores could also do the trick, no conflicts between them. And the arrangement depends on your the last operation.

A new index of helpers “Comfort Level” will be unlocked after the Police Outpost was built. The higher comfort level the more prosperous Second Homeland will be! High prosperity allows you to upgrade buildings, higher level of buildings could increase the prosperity and the prosperity will influence the income of Second Homeland.

An important part of Second Homeland. There are lots of room to build for helpers or for other functions. You can choose the building type and order freely, building upgradation is also supported and the highest level is Lv.3. Building helpers’ houses is also achieved in 0.7.
But that’s not all of our imagination of construction Zone. More types of buildings, more different facades, more colors, they are the expectations! Of course these will be put in our roadmap.

Added a new function to decoration the Second Homeland which is same as it was in farm area. Just put the acquired or crafted decors in most area of Second Homeland and make it looks like you want. We could imagine that moment you creative guys are going to show your talents.

One of the components of Second Homeland. Theme Stalls can be set around the Activity Plaza. You could choose and set the what kinds of theme stalls are, then open for business. You could sell Sugarcoat Fruits, Juices and Flowers. But some of them should be unlocked from quests.
Located in the center of Second Homeland. It’s main function is to hold all kinds of activities. But something are under preparing, so let’s skip the introduction.

notes.title: New Stories: Main Quests and Side Quests

items.text: More than just new area, there will be new main stories and side quests.

The main stories in Song of the Prairie don’t go linearly or multi-linearly, for the better and more flexible experience, we choose to tell the story like episodes. We want to give you the right to continue the story or not. Ideally, even you don’t want to involve in the stories, the experience will not be spoiled. So in the upcoming 0.7, the performance of main stories will still show as episodes.
The whole stories of second year is coming. There are four parts in main stories and each season has a unique individual story. What’s gonna happen in these stories? Let’s found out in the game.

Important side quests in second year are added in 0.7, more than 20. But that’s not all, more quests will be added and optimized in the future. We are so glade that we could continue to perfect the story line.
New Character, Sheriff

New person arrived the town, “Herman the Sheriff”. For some reasons, there is only acquaintance event and some stories about Second Homeland for him. As for the Inner Space or more events, will be completed in the future. We will not give up on every character.
Now we know little about Herman, nothing but he is a arrogant person and has connections with the new area. There will be interesting stories about this Herman I guess.
New Inner Spaces, Jin and Poline
Jin, a rich person who loves to enjoy new things. He will guide us to the new area. And we could learn more about his Inner Space. Moreover, we finally could date with him.

Poline, a special girl. Though she’s not good at architecture like her brother, but she’s gifted. Except crafts all kinds of furniture, she has a unnoticeable interest. I believe you guys have noticed that already. In 0.7, we will enter Poline’s Inner Space to know her true thoughts. And there will be two outfits for her in Inner Space, default one and special one. No doubt, player could acquire the special one.
Right! We added new outfit for fisherman in Inner Space too.
Residents in town also have changes in 0.7

For the vividness of NPCs and the logical gameplay, we improved NPCs’ feature system. First we completed some unfinished features in last version, then, we modified 13 features and adjusted some triggers of them.

This system comes with great changes. In 0.7 you will witness a more convenient and more logical operation. A new outfit changing button when interacting with NPC allows you to enter a menu to choose the corresponding parts to change their equipment.
By the way, now every part of an NPC could equip two different outfits or accessories but will not display these two simultaneously. Just switch the visibility in the menu.

One of them should be default outfit and no one could take that off. The other will be gift from players and tagged with “gifted outfit” in the menu. Every part of NPC could only equip one “gifted” outfit and accessory. Only the last gifted outfit will be kept on NPC which means the previous one will gone. But don’t be sad, NPCs will keep what you have done for them in hearts forever!
In special situations, such as Blacksmith will change her clothes during the festival, will not be taken in the consideration. Their clothes cannot be changed under that circumstance.

notes.title: New Functions of Buildings and Characters

items.text: Devs still expanded some content according to the feedback to make sure the experience can be smoother and more reasonable. Some buildings and characters will be endowed more functions. And some of their performance will be improved also.

notes.title: Don’t Worry About the Lost of Quests Props

items.text: Many players have ever faced a situation that props for quests have been lost or handed out by accident. Now, the priest will offer a service to sell props! Recycle and purchase of props will be unlocked when you acquired them. So next time, if you lost that prop, get another one from priest!

By the pushing of you guys, devs now upgrade the working station. Now you can store seeds in it. And helpers could use seeds in working station to plant under the training of our hardworking programmers!

Animal pen in new version will no longer afraid of destroying anymore.Even a little scratch will be restored as the original in the next day. And I assure you even the best carpenter cannot tell the difference.

Commissions on board have improvements too. Cookery Commissions will be added in 0.7. Besides, for the consideration of experience, refresh pattern is optimized. From now on, every kind of commissions will be refreshed at least once a month to avoid the long-term absence of some of them.
Maybe playing mini games in Garden Fair to win coupons day by day has already bothered you. Is there any better way to win those coupons? Now the answer is : YES!
We’ve added new despatch function in Guild. You could arrange helpers to work in guild. Their job is to play mini games and bring back coupons to exchange for all kinds of decors to you.
Not much Fruits & Vegetable will be added. Only one, Starfruit Tree in Winter.

But, we bring you some special plants, or, some new types of plants for more specifically speaking. We call them Ornamental trees. Their are shorter than the material trees but higher that the improved trees. More than just for decoration, they could also produce flowers and bear fruits. These are newly added trees: Kapok Tree, Locust Tree, Ginkgo Tree and Plum Tree.
Who would refuse happy festivals! So how about two more funny festivals in new version?
Summer: Water Balloon Festival

This festival will be held in Second Homeland at a certain day in summer. Unlike the water balloon game in the water park, this experience will be exceptional to you all. And you will get a special prop “water balloon” after the activities.
Winter: Snowman Festival

Falling snow is usual in winter, but it would be such a waste if you can’t build a snowman. In 0.7, we will hold a festival for you in winter to wipe out the pity. In this day, you and residents will take part in the activity to build snowmen and decorate them with beautiful stuffs. These snowmen will accompany you to go through the cold winter. And they will be decorated by colorful tape lights if you finished the specific number of snowmen.
After the Festival, you will acquire a base for snowman as a decor. Finding snowdrift in your farm and pile it into a snowball, then push this ball onto the base, that’s how to build a snowman.
We will add new outfits more or less in every update and we will do this constantly.
This time we added 3 head wears, 10 haircuts.
The game had buff system in 0.6, but the number and types are so poor. In following 0.7, we added dozens of buffs and connected them with dishes to escalate their utilization and effects.

Buff or so called “Status” in game can be divided in four types: item status, exp status, ability status, special status. Most of them have three levels and the effects change with the level going up. For the balance of gameplay, we limited players could only acquire two buffs at most, the replacement between two buffs follows a rule, and here is the partial information.

Happy times is so short. It’s a very important step to optimize game performance and it’s a stable cornerstone for the following updates. The optimization will never stop, although today’s hardware is powerful enough, but we still want the game could be run under more circumstances.

And it’s just a glimpse of new area, more stuff will be added in the future to make Second Homeland more perfect. It’s also an important part for completing Song of the Prairie. Other parts will be kept upgrading for all time, we ain’t stop here.
The stable development gives us confidence to completed version. And we thank you all for supporting us and waiting for us patiently, fueling us perpetual motivation to move on.
If you love Song of the Prairie, spread this joy to your friends. We will meet again soon！Trust me.
